svg.text: Flow 07 Stock adjustments, live sold-out and low-stock alerts
Swimlane activity diagram · one lane per actor · read top to bottom
it, by how much and why
• Reasons: Restock / delivery received, Customer return, Damaged goods, Spoilage, Manual correction (recount), Other. Damaged goods and Spoilage can only
lower stock, in the form and again on the server.
• A recipe dish has no count of its own: its stock is the servings its raw materials can make, so it changes through its raw materials.
• Separately, every hour the worker writes the items at or below their minimum to its log (lowStockSweep).
